title.zh: 简单电路 · 电流要走一圈
title.en: Simple Circuits · Current Must Go Round

description.zh: 完整闭合的回路才有电流；单回路各处电流相同；短路电流远大于正常值。灯泡电阻取常数，是理想化模型。
description.en: Current needs a complete closed loop; in a single loop it is the same everywhere; a short circuit draws far more current than normal. The bulb is a constant resistance, an idealisation.

reason.zh: 第 4 步用 P = I²R 比较灯泡亮度并判断是否超过额定功率，这是电路里“能量如何被用掉”的最简单例子。
reason.en: Step 4 compares bulb brightness with P = I²R against a rated power, the simplest example of where a circuit's energy goes.

title.en: Why is a short circuit dangerous?

ask.zh: 只有闭合的回路才有电流；如果用一根导线直接连电池两端，电流还经过灯泡吗？
ask.en: Current needs a closed loop — if a wire connects the battery's two ends directly, does the current still go through the bulb?

ask.zh: 同一节电池，电流变大很多倍，导线发热会怎样变？
ask.en: With the same battery, if the current grows many times larger, what happens to the wire's heating?

reveal.zh: 短路绕过了灯泡，回路电阻极小，电流远大于正常值，导线急剧发热，容易烧坏甚至起火。
reveal.en: A short circuit bypasses the bulb, so the loop's resistance is tiny and the current is far above normal — the wire heats up fast and can burn or catch fire.
